$comment: Banned NCERT exercise references per board/year. Used by validateQuestionBanks CI script. When a question bank file contains a ncertRef matching a banned exercise, the build fails.

rules.subject: Maths
rules.reason: NCERT Ch 13 Ex 13.3 (Frustum of Cone) was deleted from the CBSE Class 10 syllabus from 2023-24 onwards. Questions may still be valid (Ex 13.1 = Surface Area, Ex 13.2 = Volume), but the ncertRef metadata must point to Ex 13.1 or Ex 13.2.

rules.subject: Science
rules.reason: Chapter 15 (Our Environment) was removed from the CBSE Class 10 Science syllabus for 2026-27. All InText and Exercise questions referencing Ch 15 are out-of-syllabus.
